translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Ponunggelengan Moka‑atag to Bau no id Buyu to Tavang diyot Tohodhukum
Na, id itulan ni Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din to ossa pa no ponunggelengan amoy'd nonaw kandan no ko‑ilangan no inaayun sikandan od dasaa woy dii ran od ko‑obbod.
Kahi rin to, “Diyot sokkad no lugaa, duwon tohodhukum no waa allak to Monama woy id podtohon din da en kos mgo minuvu.
Duwon mandad sokkad no ba‑ay'n bau no id livodlivod taddon tohodhukum amoy od buyu to tavang nod poponoluwon sikandin to kasu, su duwon minuvu nid ayu‑ayu kandin.
Daom to mowwet no timpu, id bolivad iddos tohodhukum. Piru riyot mori, kohingginawa rin to, ‘Ahad waa allak ku to Monama woy id podtohon ku ra en kos mgo minuvu,
od tovangan ku iddon bau su id sumpuu ad moho taddot kodlivodlivod din.”
Kahin Disas to, “Poomdomma row iddos id puungan taddot dii motallong no tohodhukum. Id tovangan din iddos bau.
Na lampas pe‑en nod tavang kos Monama, oyyos dii rin en od podtohonon iddos mgo minuvu no id aam din nod nganoy kandin allow bulli.
Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no go‑os en od tavang iddos Monama kandan. Piru otik siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od livod don, duwon pobbo ayu od pomakoy?”
Dos Koddasaa to Pariseo woy taddot Tohodsukut to Buhis
Na, duwon mgo minuvu rutun nid pososalig no motallong sikandan woy id poddisokkan dan to kod‑ontong kos duma. De‑en id itulan dan ni Disas to ponunggelengan.
Kahi rin to, “Duwon oruwon minuvu no id undiyon to templo amoy'd dasaa. Dos sokkad, Pariseo woy dos sokkad, tohodsukut to buhis.

Id lohinat iddos Pariseo woy mid dasaa moka‑atag da en to ko‑ugolingun din. Kahi rin to, ‘Monama, od posolamat a kikow to koddin botasan, su konna a iling to dumon mgo minuvu. Konna a bonnong to soopi, konna a od loimbung woy konna a od loivug. Od posolamat a mandad no konna a iling duwot tohodsukut to buhis.
Ko‑oruwa a od puasa to ipat simana, woy id boggoy a mandad to iko‑sopuu no id pomon to langun no notanggap ku.’

Piru iddos tohodsukut to buhis, id po‑ibpit sikandin woy ahad kodlangngag dobbo riyot datas to langit, waad en. Iyon din da id puungan, id ounduk sikandin woy id pukpuk din kos kabpa rin pomon to kodsondit din to mgo saa rin. Kahi rin to, ‘Monama, ko‑eruwan ka koddi no mosaasaa.’ ”

Na kahin Disas to, “Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no to id uli ron iddos tohodsukut to buhis, sikandin kos id podmotallong to Monama, konna iddos Pariseo. Su iddos ahad ondoy nod poratasdatas, od poobbovan. Piru iddos od poobbava, od porotason.”
Id Pokita ni Disas kos Kopiyannoy Rin diyot mgo Anak Ukit to Koddasaa

Sokkad no allow, id piyod to mgo minuvu iddos disok no mgo anak dan diyon to ki Disas. Id kopi‑i ran no id pokita ni Disas kos kopiyannoy rin diyot mgo anak ukit to kodtoddung din to bollad din taddot uu ran diyon to koddasaa. To nokita idda taddot mgo tinodduwan din, id sugga ran sikandan.

Piru id poporani ni Disas iddos mgo anak diyot kandin, woy id ikohiyan din iddos mgo tinodduwan din to, “Podtohona row ron ikos mgo anak nod porani koddi woy yo row sikandan sugga‑a. Su iddos mgo minuvu nod salig to Monama iling to kodsalig to mgo anak, sikandan en kos no‑iraom diyon to kodharit Monama.
Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no iddos ahad ondoy no diid salig to Monama iling to kodsalig to anak, dii en od kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama.”
Dos Minuvu no Dakkoo kos Korotuwan
Na, duwon sokkad no ponguu to mgo Judio no mid intud ki Disas, kahi rin to, “Moppiyon Tohodnonaw, ondan kos ko‑ilangan nod puungan ku amoy'd pokotanggap a to umuun waad tomanon?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Mambot od ngoranan a nikkow to moppiya? Oyyos sokkad da kos moppiya, idda ra en so Monama.
Na moka‑atag taddot intud du, nokosaddoo kad man taddot mgo suhu no mid ungketen to, ‘Yo kod loivug, yo kod imatoy, yo kod ponakow, yo kod posivonnaa to uhus woy rispitu ka to amoy woy inoy ru.’ ”
Kahi taddot minuvu to, “Langun duwon no suhu, id puungan kud pomon poron to ko‑onakoy ku.”

To norinog idda ni Disas, id ikohiyan din iddos minuvu to, “Duwon pa sokkad no kulang diyot kikow. Boligya ru kos langun no korotuwan du woy pomboggoy ru kos bayad diyot worowora. Na otid puungan du ini, duwon en korotuwan du riyot datas to langit. Kopongnga, livod ka woy duma ka koddi.”
Piru to norinog idda taddot ponguu, naanu sikandin, oyyos dakkoo man kos korotuwan din.
To nokita ni Disas no naanu iddos ponguu, mid ikahi sikandin to, “Mosuppit en taddot minuvu no dakkoo kos korotuwan nod kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama.
Moomok pa iddos kod‑usok to kamelyo riyon to bobbot simat kuntra to minuvu no dakkoo kos korotuwan nod lonug diyon to kodharit Monama.”
Na iddos nokorinog tadda, mid ikahi to, “Ko ungketen, ondoy pobbo kos od kotobbus?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Iddos diid kopuungan to minuvu, od kopuungan en to Monama.”
Kahin Pedro to, “Na sikami, id tonanan doyd kos langun pomon to koddumoruma kikow.”

Kahin Disas kandan to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no iddos ahad ondoy nod tanan to mgo korotuwan din, sawa rin, mgo suwod din, amoy rin, inoy rin woy mgo anak din atag da en to kodlonug to kodharit Monama,
od pokotanggap sikandin to lampas pa taddot id tonanan din. Woy init morin allow, od pokotanggap sikandin to umuun waad tomanon.”
Dos Iko‑otollun Kodponudtuu ni Disas Moka‑atag to Kopotayan Din

Na, id livuung ni Disas iddos sopuu‑oruwon tinodduwan din, woy id ikohiyan din to, “Pominog kow, od undiyon kid to Jerusalem. Dutun, od kotuman don iddos langun nid sulat to mgo propeta moka‑atag koddi no Anak to Minuvu.
Su id boggoy a nikandan diyot bollad to konna mgo Judio, od sumpoliton a, od po‑ilawan woy'd ilobban.
Od ponlompossan
a nikandan woy kopongnga, od imotayan, piru riyot iko‑otollun allow, od kovadnow a.”
Piru waa en nokaabbot iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Disas taddot id ikahi rin, su noko‑ollos man kos kohulugan tadda.
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Minuvun Butud
Na, to morani ron onsi Disas diyot bonuwa to Jerico, duwon butud no mid ounsad diyot ibpit to daan amoy'd pokilimus.
To nokorinog iddon butud no id lihad iddos mo‑uraan minuvu rutun, id intud sikandin ko ondan idda.
Kahi taddot mgo minuvu to, “Id lihad si Disas no toho Nazaret.”
To norinog din idda, id pehes sikandin no mid ungketen to, “Disas, lubbad ni David, ko‑eruwan ka koddi!”
Na iddos mgo minuvu nid unna ki Disas, id sugga kandin amoy'd po‑onong‑onong. Piru ayas da en baling sikandin id pehes nid ungketen to, “Lubbad ni David, ko‑eruwan ka koddi!”
Na id soro si Disas, woy id pa‑angoy rin iddos butud. To nokoporani ron idda kandin, mid intud sikandin to,
“Ondan man kos id kopi‑i ru nod puungan ku kikow?” Id tavak sikandin to, “Longaggon, id kopi‑i ku nod pokokita.”
Kahin Disas kandin to, “Od pokokita kad. No‑uliyan ka pomon to kopomakoy ru.”
Idda ron en, nokokita ron iddos butud woy id duma sikandin ki Disas. Na id doong din kos Monama, woy dos langun no minuvu no nokokita tadda, id doong dan mandad kos Monama.

footnotes.text: Konna kohulugan no id ikahi ni Disas ini, no konna sikandin Monama o konna moppiya kos kodbovotasan din. Iyon unayan no id ikahi rin ini, su id kopi‑i rin no iddos ahad ondoy nod ngaran kandin to “moppiya” iling taddot id ngaran kandin no “Moppiyon Tohodnonaw,” od oonongngon din pa unna. Oyya su idda ra en so Monama kos moppiya woy dos kohulugan tadda, Monama en si Disas.
Od kovasa ini riyot Exodo 20:12-16; Levitico 19:18; Deuteronomio 5:16-20.

Diyot botasanon to mgo Judio, dii sikandan od lampas to otollumpuu siyow no kodlampos taddot od silutan dan. Dos lampos to mgo toho Roma, otollun toliyan no id ikot diyot baahon. Iddos ipat tali, duwon motaom no tullan o putow.
